content_data.meeting_title: Project 'Nexus' Visual Identity Brainstorm & Client Feedback Review
agenda_items: Alignment on communication strategy for upcoming client presentation
Review of initial mood boards and concept sketches for 'Project Nexus'
key_decisions: Agreed to merge 'futuristic-minimalist' and 'mythic-fantasy' mood board elements for a unique blend.
Confirmed the primary color palette will lean towards deep blues, purples, and subtle neons.
action_items: Schedule a follow-up meeting with the client for concept approval (Project Manager, +7 days).
Prepare a concise presentation slide deck summarizing key visual decisions for the next internal review (Creative Designer, +4 days).
